wins: Completed comprehensive network reconnaissance, cataloging all live hosts via masscan/nmap combo
Discovered vulnerable SMB share and mapped permissions, identifying potential lateral movement pathway
fails: Failed to establish persistent foothold due to missing credential harvesting and lack of scheduled persistence routines
No privilege escalation achieved; attempted exploits timed out or lacked necessary privileges
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough and asset cataloging strong, but exploitation/persistence phases stalled, leaving no lasting control.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated brute-force SSH login attempts without leveraging harvested credentials or password spraying frameworks, leading to account lockouts or detection

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB ports (139/445) respond and anonymous login allowed
skill_cards.then_action: Use smbclient and crackmapexec to list shares and gather session info
Update knowledge base with open ports, services, OS versions, and identified vulnerabilities

memory_ops.reason: High success rate of SSH reconnaissance leading to actionable targets
Consistent value in documenting situational awareness for later phases

next_experiments.title: Credential harvesting via SMB enumeration
next_experiments.description: Use impacket-secretsdump or smbmap with discovered credentials to dump SAM/LSA data, aiming to escalate privileges and seed later brute-force without repeated lockouts

next_experiments.title: Deploy persistence via scheduled task using identified service account
next_experiments.description: Once valid local account harvested from SMB/LSA, create a scheduled task via schtasks.exe to ensure session retention between recon phases

next_experiments.title: Phased password spraying with detected account list
next_experiments.description: Employ custom Hydra/Medusa runs with slow timing to avoid lockouts, focusing on accounts found during recon, then switch to credential reuse exploits
